mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 7.

Sir Patrick Stewart, the British actor best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek" and Professor Charles Xavier in "X-Men", died at home at age 86.

An 8-year-old girl was seriously injured after a wolf attacked her inside the animal enclosure at a German zoo on Wednesday.

Bayern Munich has offered roughly €60 million to Liverpool for young forward Rio Ngumoha, but Liverpool has made clear it does not intend to sell the player.

Protests demanding justice for Arlinda Zekaj will take place on Friday at noon in both Pristina and Peja, Kosovo.

Euronews Business estimates that families need a net monthly income that would put them at about 150 % of the European average to live comfortably.
